name: Aria2 Helper
subtitle: Manage aria2 from Safari
promotionalText: Send Safari links to your own aria2 engine. Track tasks, import torrents and Metalink files, and choose the files you want to download.
description:
Manage your aria2 downloads without leaving Safari.

Aria2 Helper connects Safari to an aria2-compatible JSON-RPC service that you configure. A running download engine is required; the app does not include an engine or a hosted download service.

Manage tasks
View progress, download speed and task status. Pause, resume or remove tasks from the Safari popup. On Mac, reveal files in Finder when the connected engine is running locally.

Add links and files
Paste multiple links, including magnet links supported by your engine. Import .torrent, .metalink and .meta4 files, and choose individual files inside a torrent before adding it.

Configure your connections
Use the setup guide, scan common local RPC ports on Mac, test a connection and save multiple engine profiles. Works with classic aria2 and compatible engines such as aria2-next.

Choose what to send
Set file-type filters and choose whether to forward page cookies and referer information. Automatic webpage link interception is off by default and can be enabled when needed. Download requests go to the engine you configure.

Get started
Enable Aria2 Helper in Safari's extension settings, grant access to the websites you want to use, then enter your RPC address and secret.

On iPhone and iPad, connect to an engine on another computer or server using an address your device can reach. 127.0.0.1 refers to the iPhone or iPad itself. Downloaded files are stored on the engine machine.

Liquid Glass surfaces and the popup gradient background are experimental and off by default. They are not needed to use the app.

Only download content you are authorized to access. Aria2 Helper does not provide downloadable content or bypass website access controls.
whatsNew:
Version 2.0 adds a guided setup and more flexible importing:

• Configure and test RPC connections with the setup guide.
• Import multiple torrents and Metalink files, with individual torrent file selection.
• Use file-type filters and cookie/referer forwarding controls.
• Improved compatibility with classic aria2 and aria2-next.
• Fixed failed-download fallback, settings saving and task actions.
• Fixed retries when imported files have the same name.
• Refined the popup and fixed the native launch screens.

The two experimental appearance options are off by default.
